profile.name: Sharnabh Banerjee
profile.bio: High-performing iOS Developer specializing in building native, pixel-perfect mobile applications using SwiftUI and UIKit. Proven track record in modular system design, routing optimizations, and API integrations across 10 months of intensive internship placements.
